tools.name: mofa_frame
tools.description: Extract a single video frame at a specific timestamp. Use after mofa_youtube to capture key moments identified from the transcript.

video_path.description: Path to the video file (from mofa_youtube metadata.json video_path)

timestamp.description: Timestamp in seconds to extract the frame from

label.description: Short label for the frame (used in filename)

out_path.description: Output path for the PNG (default: auto-generated in frames/ next to video)
